summary: Feature implemented but not executed: I did not run tests or flake8, so lint was checked only by reading and by line/whitespace scans. New monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; nifti_writer default dtype changed to np.float32; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (engine-accepting _finalize wrapper), and TensorBoardImageHandler (new index parameter) now delegate to savers/plot function; output_path renamed to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py updated to pass filename. Not done: docs/source automodule entries for new modules, a dedicated test for the TensorBoard handler index. Nothing committed.
